text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

translations.asad: HE FROWNED and turned away
translations.sahih: The Prophet frowned and turned away

translations.asad: because the blind man approached him!
translations.sahih: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

translations.asad: Yet for all thou didst know, [O Muhammad,] he might perhaps have grown in purity,
translations.sahih: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified

translations.asad: or have been reminded [of the truth], and helped by this reminder.
translations.sahih: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

translations.asad: Now as for him who believes himself to be self-sufficient
translations.sahih: As for he who thinks himself without need,

translations.asad: to him didst thou give thy whole attention,
translations.sahih: To him you give attention.

translations.asad: although thou art not accountable for his failure to attain to purity;
translations.sahih: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

translations.asad: but as for him who came unto thee full of eagerness
translations.sahih: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

translations.asad: and in awe [of God]
translations.sahih: While he fears [Allah],

translations.asad: him didst thou disregard!
translations.sahih: From him you are distracted.

translations.asad: NAY, VERILY, these [messages] are but a reminder:
translations.sahih: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;

translations.asad: and so, whoever is willing may remember Him
translations.sahih: So whoever wills may remember it.

translations.asad: in [the light of His] revelations blest with dignity,
translations.sahih: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

translations.asad: lofty and pure,
translations.sahih: Exalted and purified,

translations.asad: [borne] by the hands of messengers
translations.sahih: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

translations.asad: noble and most virtuous.
translations.sahih: Noble and dutiful.

translations.asad: [But only too often] man destroys himself: how stubbornly does he deny the truth!
translations.sahih: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.

translations.asad: [Does man ever consider] out of what substance [God] creates him?
translations.sahih: From what substance did He create him?

translations.asad: Out of a drop of sperm He creates him, and thereupon determines his nature,
translations.sahih: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

translations.asad: and then makes it easy for him to go through life;
translations.sahih: Then He eased the way for him;

translations.asad: and in the end He causes him to die and brings him to the grave;
translations.sahih: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

translations.asad: and then, if it be His will, He shall raise him again to life,
translations.sahih: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

translations.asad: Nay, but [man] has never yet fulfilled what He has enjoined upon him!
translations.sahih: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

translations.asad: Let man, then, consider [the sources of] his food:
translations.sahih: Then let mankind look at his food -

translations.asad: [how it is] that We pour down water, pouring it down abundantly;
translations.sahih: How We poured down water in torrents,

translations.asad: and then We cleave the earth [with new growth], cleaving it asunder,
translations.sahih: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

translations.asad: and thereupon We cause grain to grow out of it,
translations.sahih: And caused to grow within it grain

translations.asad: and vines and edible plants,
translations.sahih: And grapes and herbage

translations.asad: and olive trees and date-palms,
translations.sahih: And olive and palm trees

translations.asad: and gardens dense with foliage,
translations.sahih: And gardens of dense shrubbery

translations.asad: and fruits and herbage,
translations.sahih: And fruit and grass -

translations.asad: for you and for your animals to enjoy.
translations.sahih: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.

translations.asad: AND SO, when the piercing call [of resurrection] is heard
translations.sahih: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

translations.asad: on a Day when everyone will [want to] flee from his brother,
translations.sahih: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

translations.asad: and from his mother and father,
translations.sahih: And his mother and his father

translations.asad: and from his spouse and his children:
translations.sahih: And his wife and his children,

text.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ

translations.asad: on that Day, to every one of them will his own state be of sufficient concern.
translations.sahih: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

translations.asad: Some faces will on that Day be bright with happiness,
translations.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

translations.asad: laughing, rejoicing at glad tidings.
translations.sahih: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

translations.asad: And some faces will on that Day with dust be covered,
translations.sahih: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

translations.asad: with darkness overspread:
translations.sahih: Blackness will cover them.

translations.asad: these, these will be the ones who denied the truth and were immersed in iniquity!
translations.sahih: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
